correctness.rationale: The centered crossing kernel has first projection variance 1/45; exact geometric integration yields a(t)=q(t)^2/6. The degenerate remainder has O(n^2) variance, negligible on n^3 variance scale, and bounded conditional iid vectors give the full mixed-normal joint CLT. The exact finite covariance follows from counting overlaps. Source code checked from the included file and 142 rational assertions passed.

value.rationale: A natural deletion influence statistic for crossing density has an n-scale geometric part and a smaller sqrt(n)-scale stochastic part. The explicit conditional covariance distinguishes independence of the large-scale deletion response from dependence of local error on global fluctuations, enabling principled leave-one-out calibration in random circle graphs. This is a nontrivial conditional distributional classification, not a change of variable in a known marginal law.
